Alaska Air Group, Inc. Announces Consolidated Operating Results for the Month and Year to Date Ended September 2019. Alaska Air Group, Inc. announced consolidated operating results for the month and year to date ended September 2019. For the year to date, the company reported revenue passengers of 35,018,000 compared to 34,685,000 a year ago. Revenue passenger miles were 42,113,000,000 compared to 41,272,000,000 a year ago. Available seat miles were 50,006,000,000 compared to 49,256,000,000 a year ago. Passenger load factor was 84.2% compared to 83.8% a year ago.
